primitives.name: Deployment Gate Sequencing
primitives.verbatim_quote: > Guiding rule: **everything ships dark, then you open one gate at a time, in order.** > `node scripts/check-deploy-readiness.mjs` enforces the order and blocks unsafe combinations > (it already fails the deploy if `DEV_FAKE_ADMIN` or `DEMO_PICKS_ENABLED` are true in prod).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G_i': 'Boolean flag indicating whether gate i is open (0 or 1)', 'T': 'Time index for ordered activation sequence'}
primitives.assumptions: All gates must be activated in strictly increasing temporal order T; unsafe combinations are blocked by readiness logic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when G_i = 1 while G_{i-1} ≠ 1, violating sequential integrity.

layer2.mapping: Each gate corresponds to a conditional probability in a Bayesian belief network where P(G_i=1|G_{i-1}=1) = 1 under valid deployment.
layer2.telemetry: Verification that each gate transition is logged and validated by readiness script.

primitives.name: Pricing Consistency Check
primitives.verbatim_quote: at the advertised interval, in the advertised currency** (all six vars — pro/elite/fantasy × monthly/annual — compared against `apps/web/lib/pricing/pricing-phases.ts`; a mismatch is a hard failure, not a warning), Redis pings, `apps/web/vercel.json` crons + security headers present, gate sequencing sane.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{ij}': 'Price for plan i at interval j (monthly/annual)', 'C_{ij}': 'Currency code for plan i at interval j', 'I_{ij}': 'Interval duration for plan i at interval j'}
primitives.assumptions: All pricing variables must exactly match predefined constants in `pricing-phases.ts`.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Hard failure if any (P_ij, C_ij, I_ij) tuple mismatches expected values.

layer2.mapping: Enforces a constraint kernel on pricing parameters as a consistency oracle within the GSE's configuration space.
layer2.telemetry: Script output confirms all 6 pricing tuples align with static definitions.

primitives.name: Dark Mode Bootstrap
primitives.verbatim_quote: The public site renders its honest bootstrap/stub states (no public picks, no performance stats).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S(t)': 'System state at time t during initial deployment', 'B(t)': 'Bootstrap stub state (public picks = false, stats = false)'}
primitives.assumptions: Initial system behavior is deterministic and non-revenue generating until gates are opened.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If S(t) ≠ B(t), indicates premature exposure or misconfiguration.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a controlled initialization function in GSI where S(0) = B(0) until explicit activation.
layer2.telemetry: Public-facing UI renders stubbed content without sensitive data.

This mirrors a causal Bayesian network where each gate represents a conditional dependency. The failure mode arises from violating either the logical ordering (G_i=1 before G_{i-1}) or the semantic correctness (pricing mismatch).
